changeSubject: Confirm your new sign-in email for {gym}
changeDescription: Someone asked to make this address the sign-in email of their account at {gym}. Open this link within an hour to confirm the change. It can be used once.
changeIgnore: If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email: nothing changes until the link is opened.
noticeSubject: Your sign-in email for {gym} was changed
noticeDescription: The sign-in email of your account at {gym} was changed to {email}. This address no longer signs in, and your other sessions were ended.
noticeHelp: If you didn't make this change, contact {gym} right away.
confirmDescription: Confirm to make this address your sign-in email. Your other sessions end, and your previous address gets a notice.
confirmExpired: This link is invalid, expired or already used. Ask for a new one on your account page.
confirmOtherLogin: Another login is signed in on this browser. Sign out, or open the link in another browser.
confirmTaken: Another login now uses this address, so the change can't apply.
confirmError: The change could not be confirmed. Try again.
confirmSessions: Sessions on other devices were ended.
javascriptRequired: JavaScript is required to confirm the change.
title: Your account
description: How you sign in here, and what you can reach.
loadError: Your account could not be loaded.
emailLinkOn: On: a link is sent to your sign-in email
emailLinkOff: Off: this gym can't send email
passwordOff: Password sign-in is off for this gym
googleNotLinked: Not linked: sign in with Google using your sign-in email to link it
noAccess: No staff role or household here.
changeHelp: We send a link to the new address. The change applies only when it is opened, within an hour. Your other sessions then end, and your current address gets a notice.
changeGoogle: Your linked Google account is unlinked when the change applies. Sign in with the Google account of the new address to link it again.
pending: A link was sent to {email}. Open it before {time} to apply the change. Asking again replaces it.
unavailableSeveralGyms: This install runs several gyms and your sign-in email is shared by every gym you belong to, so it can't be changed here.
unavailableNoEmail: This gym can't send email yet, so a confirmation link can't be sent. Once email is set up in Settings, you can change it here; an owner can also change their own with gym-app auth change-email on the server.
errorSame: This is already your sign-in email.
errorRateLimited: Too many requests. Try again later.
errorGeneric: The link could not be sent. Try again.
